help:
Move a managed headless worker to another machine (P0 cold migration).

stop -> ship (worktree + harness session file + identity) -> resume on
the target with the transferred sessionRef.  The resume is STRICT: if
the session does not come back on the target, the transfer fails and
the source is rolled back rather than silently cold-starting.

parameters.name: name
parameters.help: Managed headless worker name.

parameters.name: to
parameters.help: SSH destination: [user@]<exact nodeId from this home's hyprial host list>.

parameters.name: harness
parameters.help: Disambiguate when several harnesses share the name.

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.help: Target directory; required across SSH login users (same-path default only for the same user).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.help: Validate and print the plan; change nothing (requires --yes).

parameters.name: yes
parameters.help: Confirm the reported remote command, daemon.socket and actor.

parameters.name: strict_timeout
parameters.help: Seconds the target waits for the resumed worker to come ready.

parameters.name: remote_hyprial
parameters.help: Remote command (default: hyprial). Non-default values are rehearsal-only and require a non-default source HYPRIAL_HOME override, e.g. 'HYPRIAL_HOME=/tmp/hyprial-tgt /home/me/transfer-p0/.venv/bin/hyprial'.

parameters.name: containerized
parameters.help: Land the worker inside a docker container carrying the source owner's credentials (design docs/design/design-transfer-container.md).

parameters.name: image
parameters.help: Worker image reference (default: hyprial-worker:<this hyprial version>).

parameters.name: with_credentials
parameters.help: Ship the source owner's credential bundle (containerized mode only; --no-credentials exists for mutation testing).

parameters.name: json_output
parameters.help: Emit JSON only.

help: Pack an agent home into a transfer bundle (AT06 transport unit).

parameters.name: source_dir
parameters.help: Agent home directory to pack (the transfer unit is a copy, not a move).

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.help: Destination bundle directory: must not exist, or be an empty directory; it must not be the source home, contain it, or sit inside it.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.help: Owner the bundle belongs to.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.help: Agent actor name being transported.

parameters.name: machine
parameters.help: Source machine id (default: HYPRIAL_NODE_ID, else the host name).

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.help: ISO timestamp to record (default: now, local offset).

parameters.name: session_ref
parameters.help: Session reference the bundle carries (repeatable).

parameters.name: grant
parameters.help: Capability grant the bundle declares (repeatable).

parameters.name: allow_live
parameters.help: Pack even though the source still has a live daemon (best effort, not a snapshot).

parameters.name: json_output
parameters.help: Emit JSON only.

help: Verify a transfer bundle before receiving it (AT06 pre-receive gate).

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.help: Bundle directory to verify.

parameters.name: expect_owner
parameters.help: Refuse when the bundle carries a different owner than this one.

parameters.name: expect_actor
parameters.help: Refuse when the bundle carries a different actor than this one.

parameters.name: json_output
parameters.help: Emit JSON only.

help: Land a validated transfer bundle at its target home (AT07 receive gate).

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.help: Bundle directory to land.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.help: Target agent home; refused unless it is absent or an empty directory.

parameters.name: expect_actor
parameters.help: Refuse when the bundle carries a different actor than this one.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.help: Validate and report what would land, without writing anything.

parameters.name: json_output
parameters.help: Emit JSON only.

help:
Land a received bundle as one of this node's own agents (AT07).

The identity half of a receive, and the only half the CLI cannot do by
itself: the daemon mints the agent row and the home that incarnation owns,
moves the payload into it, and materialises the manifest's grants.  A name
already in use is refused before a byte moves.  Use
``transfer-bundle-receive`` only for a destination the registry does not
manage.

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.help: Bundle directory this node has received.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.help: Refuse a bundle whose actor is not this one.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.help: Report what a landing would do; change nothing.

parameters.name: json_output
parameters.help: Emit JSON only.

help: Seal credentials for a transfer bundle (AT06 credential envelope, prototype).

parameters.name: credentials_file
parameters.help: JSON object mapping credential name to value.

parameters.name: envelope_file
parameters.help: Sealed envelope to write; readable only by the target's private key.

parameters.name: recipient_public_key
parameters.help: Base64 raw X25519 public key of the target machine.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.help: Agent actor the credentials belong to.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.help: Owner the credentials belong to.

parameters.name: record
parameters.help: Per-credential risk metadata as JSON; repeatable.

parameters.name: host_owner_grant
parameters.help: Only when the host owner explicitly let this landing use host credentials.

parameters.name: use_host_credentials
parameters.help: Request host credentials; refused without an explicit host owner grant.

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.help: ISO timestamp to record (default: now, local offset).

parameters.name: prototype
parameters.help: Acknowledge this envelope is a replaceable prototype, not a frozen protocol.

parameters.name: json_output

parameters.name: key_file
parameters.help: File holding this machine's raw 32-byte X25519 private key (or its base64).

parameters.name: prototype

help: Complete a transfer-out: clean the source by identity fence (AT11).

parameters.name: home
parameters.help: Source agent home to clean up once the target holds the agent.

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.help: Bundle that must still validate before anything on the source is removed.

parameters.name: receipt
parameters.help: Target confirmation id: the target says it holds the agent.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.help: Agent actor being handed over.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.help: Owner the agent belongs to.

parameters.name: staging
parameters.help: Staging directory to clean (repeatable).

parameters.name: credential_volume
parameters.help: Container credential volume to clean (repeatable).

parameters.name: private_grant
parameters.help: Private grant file or directory to clean (repeatable).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.help: List what would be removed, without removing anything.

parameters.name: allow_uncovered
parameters.help: Delete files the bundle does not hold. Without this the removal is refused when the home has moved on since the export.

parameters.name: allow_external
parameters.help: Delete --staging / --credential-volume / --private-grant paths that are not under a root this actor owns. Without it those paths are refused.

parameters.name: json_output
parameters.help: Emit JSON only.

help:
Prepare (or permission-seal) the credential staging dir on the target.

The orchestrator scp's the credential bundle and the image tar into the
returned directory.  ``--finalize`` runs AFTER the uploads: staging
dirs become 0700 and every staged file 0600 (scp does not preserve
modes).  Nothing here reads file contents.
